title: R6D dense recurrence iteration-cost and scaling audit
question: What is the warm dense-kernel time per R6D BP iteration, how linear is it in a forced iteration cap, and how much of the current default pipeline is fixed graph/packing overhead?

scope.records: first 20 frozen R6N trajectories in trajectory-index order

acceptance: dense prepacked kernel agrees with the public dense wrapper on every default record
every forced-cap run performs its requested iteration count
all measurements exclude one-time JIT compilation and report it separately
claim_boundary: CPU microbenchmark only. It does not predict single-instance GPU latency, batched GPU throughput, larger-size scaling, or any changed BP approximation.
